{{Top|leg}}
A '''metal detector''', '''metal sensor''',<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref> or '''metal scanner''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The sensor could also be used to detect metallic salvage<ref name="PoG2">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]''</ref> and search for metallic [[Ore/Legends|ores]] during [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations.<ref name="FBS" /> Metal detectors were employed as security devices at the [[Lola Curich Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].<ref name="ML">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref>
